Engineering stress uses original cross-section and inertia-corrected force. Upper yield is the maximum at onset of discontinuous yielding, distinct from lower yield or offset proof stress. Parent material is full thickness except approximately 0.006 in removed in strain-gauge regions of highest-rate specimens. Room temperature is stated but no numerical test temperature is given.
